observations.classification: Scoped nonfinding and historical confirmation; no new repair identity
observations.trace: BufferLabel owns private String and From<String>/From<&str> preserve text; optional BufferDefinition.label passes a borrowed value to wgpu::BufferDescriptor.label. Native wgpu aliases BufferDescriptor to the wgpu-types descriptor with optional str Label, and wgpu-types documents that field as a debugging label. PassParameters separately uses String keys to find parameters.
observations.qualification: No local nonempty/identifier validation was found in the displayed constructors; empty and arbitrary text pass those constructors. This alone does not prove acceptance by every backend. Native label and shader parameter key have different roles; do not conflate their admission policies. 059 q317/2331 retain shader-name propagation as separate open contracts.

observations.trace: GPU data reexports fabelgeist_math math, matrix, transform and vector; PassParameter imports Mat2/3/4, Transform and Vec2/3/4 through that data module. The math crate defines/reexports those modules.

observations.classification: Independent bounded confirmation of existing conditional /root/rig_identity candidate REVIEW-GPU-BUFFER-MAP-USAGE-COMBINATION-95E; no duplicate count
observations.trace: A caller can build storage() plus HostRead; the builder combines STORAGE, COPY_SRC, COPY_DST and MAP_READ and forwards those flags to the native descriptor after Buffer::new checks nonzero length. Locked wgpu-types documents that without MAPPABLE_PRIMARY_BUFFERS, MAP_READ may accompany only COPY_DST.
observations.qualification: The exact condition requires such a caller and a device lacking the feature. Neither ordinary reachability, feature enablement, native validation result nor product behavior was observed here. The prior author connected RIG-ADMISSION03-ADDITIONAL-087 and 059 q1833; preserve the earlier attribution and no duplicate count. API policy may deliberately delegate native validation. Later remedy, if required by owner policy, should admit feature-dependent combinations or retain explicit delegated validation without removing legitimate map-only/storage-copy cases.

observations.qualification: Logical and allocation size may intentionally differ. Existing assessment and q352 retain their own conditions, consumers, authors and overlap decisions; no current pipeline, invalid buffer, native call or panic ran.

lens_perspectives.assessment: BufferLabel producers preserve supplied text to optional native descriptor; PassParameters uses a separate key path. Wider producer/caller graphs remain open.
BufferLabel owns diagnostic text; fabelgeist-math owns the reexported math definitions. Shader parameter identity is a separate previously recorded owner question.
String conversions introduce no visible label grammar; the existing conditional usage combination requires feature and API-policy qualification.
Conversions preserve the label contents; inspected usage union may compose feature-restricted flags, and i32 conversion is linked to an earlier signed-kind ABI question.
Public Buffer handle, size and usage can diverge after initial construction; prior current assessment and q352 retain their scope and conditions.
The shared GPU layer owns the diagnostic wrapper while math retains its canonical definitions. Do not treat the math reexport or native descriptor as a competing owner.
Reexporting the same math definitions does not establish duplicated authority; stored native and wrapper metadata remain an existing conditional coherence question.
Preserve exact supplied diagnostic spelling, absence versus present label, and legitimate storage/map modes in any future repair; native display and backend outcomes remain unobserved.
UsageSelection distinguishes unspecified from explicit flags, and BufferUse owns individual meanings; combinations must respect the native device contract if the API promises admission.
Displayed conversion implementations project owned or borrowed text; no source evidence establishes a safe mechanical derive replacement or full trait surface.
Diagnostic label, shader lookup key, byte extent and usage flags are distinct roles despite underlying strings or integers; unrelated namespaces are outside scope.
Open diagnostic labels serve backend tooling; lookup strings separately retain q317/2331, not an automatic common identifier or nonempty policy.
Native bit flags and buffer byte lengths have existing units and owners; no gameplay tuning or universal numeric domain follows from this narrow scope.
